ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast; approximately 40:60 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Right lobe consists of a large, contiguous high-intensity (white) geometric field bounded by a dark trailing edge; left lobe is characterized by a contiguous low-intensity (dark) field populated with high-density white point-mottling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a measured acute interior angle and high vertical-to-horizontal bounding box depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Right lobe trailing edge displays high-frequency, high-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) visible against the sky; left lobe trailing edge displays lower-frequency, irregular topography.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edges tapering to acute points at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of circular, high-contrast white pixel groups (barnacle scars) localized on the left lobe and lower peduncle.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant jagged truncation and irregular pixel boundary at the distal tip of the right lobe with dangling low-intensity debris/filaments; small irregular notch at the left distal tip.
other_distinctive_markers: High-density white speckling (salt-and-pepper pattern) that transitions into solid dark pigmentation toward the median notch.
